section: Structure of the Indian financial system - banks, NBFCs, development finance institutions, cooperatives
subsections: Development finance institutions - year and sector
All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions

accepted.s: Which one of the following institutions was established on a World Bank initiative and later became a universal bank?
o: Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India
accepted.x: ICICI was established in 1955 on a World Bank initiative and subsequently became a universal bank.
accepted.tq: Identify the institution through its founding association and later transformation.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to the Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI), consider the following statements:
1. It was established in 1964 under the Reserve Bank of India.
2. It became autonomous in 1976.
3. It was reverse-merged with IDBI Bank in 2002.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. IDBI was established under RBI in 1964, became autonomous in 1976 and was reverse-merged with IDBI Bank in 2002.
accepted.tq: Check the institutional timeline statement by statement.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Industrial Reconstruction Corporation of India (IRCI), established in 1971, was primarily associated with which sector?
accepted.x: IRCI was established in 1971 for industrial reconstruction.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its specialised sector.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Export-Import Bank of India?
o: Established in 2021; provides infrastructure finance and has its headquarters in Chennai
Established in January 1982; provides foreign-trade finance and has its headquarters in New Delhi
Established in July 1948; provides long-term industrial finance and has its headquarters in Mumbai
Established in 1988; provides housing finance and has its headquarters in New Delhi
accepted.x: EXIM Bank was established in January 1982, supports foreign-trade finance including lines of credit abroad, and is headquartered in New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Split the options by checking year, sector and headquarters together.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) was established on which date?
accepted.x: NABARD was established on 12 July 1982 under the NABARD Act, 1981.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely spaced institutional dates.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The establishment of NABARD was based on the recommendations of which committee?
accepted.x: NABARD was established on the basis of the B. Sivaraman Committee recommendations relating to CRAFICARD.
accepted.tq: Use the committee–institution association rather than the sector alone.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the National Housing Bank (NHB)?
o: It was established in 1982 under the NABARD Act, 1981, as an apex rural finance institution.
It was established in 1990 as an apex institution for MSME finance.
It was established in 1988 under the NHB Act, 1987, as an apex housing finance institution.
It was established in 2021 as an apex infrastructure finance institution.
accepted.x: NHB was established in 1988 under the NHB Act, 1987, and functions as an apex housing finance institution.
accepted.tq: Trap the swapped sectors and years of specialised financial institutions.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Reserve Bank of India’s stake in the National Housing Bank was transferred to the Government in:
accepted.x: The RBI’s stake in NHB was transferred to the Government in 2019.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-reform year as the decisive clue.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding SIDBI:
1. The SIDBI Act was passed in 1989.
2. SIDBI commenced operations on 2 April 1990.
3. It began as a subsidiary of IDBI.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. SIDBI was created under the 1989 Act, began operations on 2 April 1990 and initially functioned as an IDBI subsidiary.
accepted.tq: Verify the Act year, operational date and institutional origin separately.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SIDBI is primarily concerned with finance for which of the following sectors?
o: Foreign trade and overseas lines of credit
accepted.x: SIDBI is the specialised financial institution for micro, small and medium enterprises.
accepted.tq: Associate the institution with its principal beneficiary sector.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NaBFID was established under the NaBFID Act, 2021, primarily for financing which sector?
accepted.x: NaBFID was established in 2021 as a development finance institution focused on infrastructure financing.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the newest DFI by its specialised mandate.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The initial capital structure of NaBFID consisted of which of the following?
accepted.x: NaBFID received initial capital of ₹20,000 crore along with a ₹5,000 crore grant.
accepted.tq: Separate capital from grant while reading paired figures.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the present classification of IDBI Bank after LIC acquired majority control in 2019?
o: It became a refinance institution under RBI.
It was reclassified as a cooperative bank.
It was reclassified as a private sector bank.
It was converted into a foreign bank.
accepted.x: After LIC acquired majority control in 2019, IDBI Bank was reclassified as a private sector bank.
accepted.tq: Apply the ownership change to the resulting regulatory classification.
accepted.sec: Development finance institutions - year and sector  [APPSC]

accepted.s: For regulatory purposes, which of the following are classified by the Reserve Bank of India as refinance institutions?
accepted.x: RBI classifies NABARD, NHB and SIDBI as refinance institutions. EXIM Bank is classified as a term-lending institution.
accepted.tq: Separate refinance institutions from term-lending institutions.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following institutions are regulated and supervised by the Reserve Bank of India as All-India Financial Institutions?
o: IFCI, ICICI, IDBI, IIBI and LIC
EXIM Bank, NABARD, NHB, SIDBI and NaBFID
NABARD, LIC, GIC, UTI and SIDCs
NHB, SIDBI, IFCI, TFCI and SFCs
accepted.x: The five RBI-regulated and supervised AIFIs are EXIM Bank, NABARD, NHB, SIDBI and NaBFID.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure institutional names and eliminate older classifications.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the distinction between RBI-regulated AIFIs and refinance institutions?
o: All RBI-regulated AIFIs are classified as refinance institutions.
NABARD, NHB and SIDBI are refinance institutions, whereas EXIM Bank is a term-lending institution.
Only NHB is both an AIFI and a refinance institution.
EXIM Bank and NaBFID alone are refinance institutions.
accepted.x: NABARD, NHB and SIDBI are classified as refinance institutions for regulatory purposes, while EXIM Bank is a term-lending institution.
accepted.tq: Look for the precise classification rather than assuming all AIFIs have the same role.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NABARD’s refinance disbursement during 2024–25 was reported as approximately:
accepted.x: NABARD’s refinance disbursement in 2024–25 was ₹3,25,497.81 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the large refinance figure from the separate RIDF support figure.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF) support provided by NABARD in 2024–25 was:
accepted.x: NABARD’s RIDF support in 2024–25 was ₹42,714 crore.
accepted.tq: Read the separate fund-support figure independently from total refinance disbursement.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched under the older classification of financial institutions?
o: State-level financial institutions — LIC, GIC and UTI
Specialised financial institutions — RCTC and TFCI
All-India development financial institutions — LIC and GIC
accepted.x: Under the older classification, RCTC and TFCI were specialised financial institutions. LIC, GIC and UTI were investment institutions, while SFCs and SIDCs were state-level financial institutions.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and reject category swaps.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the National Housing Bank?
accepted.x: NHB launched RESIDEX in 2007. CRAFICARD is associated with the B. Sivaraman Committee and RIDF with NABARD.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly associated institutional terms.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to housing finance companies, consider the following statements:
1. Regulation of HFCs moved from NHB to RBI under the Finance Act, 2019.
2. NHB continues to exercise supervision and provide refinance.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
accepted.x: Both statements are correct. RBI assumed regulation of HFCs under the Finance Act, 2019, while NHB retained supervision and refinance functions.
accepted.tq: Separate regulation from supervision and refinance functions.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the RMBS Development Company Limited (RDCL):
1. The Reserve Bank of India granted it a Certificate of Registration in January 2025.
2. NHB contributed equity to it.
3. It is intended to develop the residential mortgage-backed securities market.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. RDCL received RBI registration in January 2025, had equity participation from NHB and was created to deepen the residential mortgage-backed securities market.
accepted.tq: Treat the date, institutional participation and objective as separate checks.
accepted.sec: All-India Financial Institutions - number, RBI-regulated, refinance institutions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is included in the organised financial system?
o: State Trading Corporation of India and mutual funds
accepted.x: STCI and mutual funds are included in the organised, RBI-regulated financial system. Indigenous bankers, moneylenders, unregulated finance companies and chit funds belong to the unorganised system in the classification given.
accepted.tq: Separate regulated organised institutions from unorganised intermediaries.
accepted.sec: Organised vs unorganised financial system  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following sets consists entirely of instruments or markets associated with the organised financial system?
o: Artisans, farmers, small traders and nidhis
Call money, Treasury bills, commercial bills and certificates of deposit
Indigenous bankers, chit funds, nidhis and moneylenders
Unregulated loan companies, repo, nidhis and moneylenders
accepted.x: Call money, Treasury bills, commercial bills and certificates of deposit are components of the organised financial system. The other sets include unorganised institutions or users.
accepted.tq: Classify each item before selecting the all-organised set.
accepted.sec: Organised vs unorganised financial system  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following instruments is associated with the organised financial system rather than the unorganised financial system?
accepted.x: Repo is an organised financial-market instrument. Chit funds, nidhis and indigenous banking are listed under the unorganised system.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between organised-market instruments and informal institutions.
accepted.sec: Organised vs unorganised financial system  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The unorganised financial system primarily serves which of the following groups?
o: Only listed companies and mutual funds
accepted.x: The unorganised financial system serves farmers, artisans and small traders.
accepted.tq: Identify the clientele associated with informal finance.
accepted.sec: Organised vs unorganised financial system  [APPSC]

accepted.s: An indigenous banker is best described as one who:
o: Accepts deposits and lends, while also combining banking with trade or commission business
Provides only long-term loans to infrastructure companies
Operates exclusively under the supervision of the RBI
Only lends in kind and does not accept deposits
accepted.x: An indigenous banker accepts deposits and lends, while combining banking activities with trade or commission business. Shroffs and Mahajans are examples.
accepted.tq: Use the functional definition and reject the extreme ‘only’ statement.
accepted.sec: Organised vs unorganised financial system  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Chit funds — regulated by State Governments under the Chit Funds Act, 1982
Indigenous bankers — persons who lend only in kind
accepted.x: Indigenous bankers accept deposits and lend, while also undertaking trade or commission business; they are not defined as persons who lend only in kind.
accepted.tq: Find the definition that reverses the essential feature of the institution.
accepted.sec: Organised vs unorganised financial system  [APPSC]
